limitations: This is a translation/source-transfer and workflow handoff, not a critical edition.

Package itself says Paper 02 German source/control visibly skips Section 4 and jumps from Chapter I Section 6 to Chapter III Section 7; those gaps are preserved as source-review flags, not silently filled.
Paper 24 and later sections include working/update layers in status metadata; do not infer complete numbered-corpus Slavic closure from the file count alone.
Large ZIP belongs on Zenodo/Drive or raw/provenance storage, not as a GitHub binary.
Some included historical logs mention earlier GitHub upload blockage in another environment; this manifest supersedes that by cataloging the local handoff in the GitHub mirror metadata.
recommended_next_action: Stage on the Noether Zenodo record or Drive handoff as a large Slavic translation/source-transfer artifact with explicit working-lane caveats; update public record descriptions without calling it source-closed or critically certified.
